title: Police Blotter: 17 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County jail in this end-of-day roundup covering arrests from Sunday, November 1, into Monday, November 2, 2026, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records. The charges below are allegations, and each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.
body: Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County jail in this end-of-day roundup, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records. The entries below cover arrests from Sunday, November 1, into Monday, November 2, 2026.
The charges listed below are allegations. Each person named is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.
## 1. SANCHEZ, CRISTIAN XAVIER

Cristian Xavier Sanchez was arrested at 1:18 a.m. on Sunday, November 1, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department. He was charged with possession of marijuana, 2 ounces or less, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 2. MARTINEZ, ABRAHAM

Abraham Martinez was arrested at 2:27 p.m. on Sunday, November 1, 2026, by the Department of Public Safety. He was charged with driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 3. DE LA GARZA, JAVIER

Javier De La Garza was arrested at 8:20 p.m. on Sunday, November 1, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department. He was charged with assault causing bodily injury, family violence, a Class A misdemeanor, and resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 4. RIVAS-MEDINA, JOSE DE JESUS

Jose De Jesus Rivas-Medina was arrested at 10:54 p.m. on Sunday, November 1, 2026, by the Webb County Sheriff's Office. He was charged with driving while intoxicated / open alcohol container, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 5. MARTINEZ, JUAN

Juan Martinez was arrested at 11:26 p.m. on Sunday, November 1, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department. He was charged with assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor, and public intoxication, a Class C misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 6. ANGUIANO, RUBEN

Ruben Anguiano was arrested at 12:31 a.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was charged with public intoxication, a Class C misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 7. REYES, ALEJANDRO

Alejandro Reyes was arrested at 1:50 a.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department. He was charged with public intoxication, a Class C misdemeanor, and criminal mischief $100 to under $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $100 and $1,000.
## 8. JUAREZ-JUAREZ, MIGUEL

Miguel Juarez-Juarez was arrested at 7:16 a.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was charged with driving while intoxicated, 2nd offense, a Class A misdemeanor, and driving while license invalid, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $3,500 and $2,500.
## 9. RIOS, ANGEL

Angel Rios was arrested at 9:38 a.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was charged with possession of marijuana, under 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 10. SALINAS, JAVIER ARMANDO

Javier Armando Salinas was arrested at 2:21 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026, by the United States Marshals. He was charged with a federal violation and is held on a federal / Bureau of Prisons hold. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 11. REYES, JOSE LUIS

Jose Luis Reyes was arrested at 5:29 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026, by Border Patrol. He was charged with reentry of a deported alien (18 USC 1326, federal violation), possession of marijuana, 2 ounces or less, a Class B misdemeanor, failure to identify, giving false/fictitious information, a Class A misdemeanor, and evading arrest/detention, a Class A misdemeanor. He is also held on a federal / Border Patrol hold. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 12. CORTES-ROSA, JESSICA MARIE

Jessica Marie Cortes-Rosa was arrested at 5:34 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department. She was charged with theft of property $100 to under $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 13. MARTINEZ, CARLOS GABRIEL

Carlos Gabriel Martinez was arrested at 5:45 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026. The arresting agency was listed as Out of County. He was charged with burglary of vehicle, a Class A misdemeanor, and is held on an out-of-county/state hold. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 14. CRUZ, MARIA GUADALUPE

Maria Guadalupe Cruz was arrested at 6:25 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026, by the US Marshals. She was charged with a federal violation and is held on a federal / US Marshals hold. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 15. HERNANDEZ-CALDERON, PEDRO

Pedro Hernandez-Calderon was arrested at 7:42 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026, by the US Marshals. He was charged with a federal violation and is held on a federal / United States Marshals hold. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 16. RAMIREZ, ENRIQUE

Enrique Ramirez was arrested at 9:15 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026, by the Constable's Office Precinct 1. He was charged with driving while intoxicated, 2nd offense, a Class A misdemeanor, and driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
## 17. GARZA, LUIS A

Luis A Garza was arrested at 11:03 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was charged with harassment, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of this report.
Webb Watch 956 will continue to follow these cases as they move through the courts. Anyone with additional information about these arrests is asked to contact the arresting agency listed above.
